statement: RunPod lists on-demand B300 pods at $7.39 per GPU-hour as of its July 27, 2026 price update
why: A dated rental level for the newest part, with no earlier price on the page to compare against.

impact.mechanism: Published on-demand rate sets a cost reference for newest-generation rented capacity; static level with no baseline, so no direction.

confidence.basis: Vendor pricing page with an on-page date stamp, but a single provider and secondary tier.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.99 -> 7.39 (tol 1%); sources: RunPod
